quality.content.summary: No seed caption, no pre-filled email/password disclosed to anonymous visitors on /login; form works with 'Invalid credentials' alert on fake login, stays on /login, forgot-password line present. Chrome's own saved-password autofill visually showed admin@local but underlying DOM value was confirmed empty via :-webkit-autofill probe, matching the brief's caveat that browser autofill is not app behaviour.

limitations: Seed-credential grep scoped to apps/web/src only (per brief instruction), not repo-wide.
